reader_summary.overview: I'm your host, Eddie Palmgen, and with me here in the studio is my friend and colleague, Nicholas Savos. And today, we are really excited to speak to Chris Waller. Chris is the founder and portfolio manager of plural investing in New York City.

thesis: Chris Waller argues that the book 'We Are Bellingcat' demonstrates how open-source information and social media allow ordinary people to uncover truths about global events, sometimes surpassing the capabilities of professional intelligence agencies. He notes that while the book was not initially read with investment in mind, it has significantly impacted his approach by showing the value of digging into topics using tools like YouTube, Twitter, and Google Maps.
